title: Trauma endures in Paris suburb after police grenade shatters teenager's jaw
subhead: On September 28, 14-year-old Eden suffered a fractured jaw and lost most of his teeth after he was struck in the face by a tear-gas grenade fired at close range, just a few meters from his high school, where a protest was taking place. Students, teachers and parents spoke of their fear, anger and sense of helplessness.

title: How the Trump administration wages its diplomatic offensive against abortion rights
subhead: Since the abrupt halt of USAID, bilateral agreements driven by American interests have replaced humanitarian aid. One of the key provisions is the refusal to fund the promotion or practice of abortion, especially in Africa.

title: French citizen sued by his former employer, Thales, has languished in Azerbaijani prisons since 2022
subhead: 'A forgotten Frenchman in Baku' (1/2). Mehmet Sahan, a French-Turkish dual national who ran Thales's Azerbaijan office for seven years, has been detained in the country since February 2022, following a lawsuit from his former employer. He fears for his life, and his lawyers have called for him to be repatriated.

title: What Jorgen Watne Frydnes, chair of the Nobel Peace Prize committee, knows about peace
subhead: At only 41, the Norwegian will present the Nobel Peace Prize for the third time on Friday. Previously, he helped rebuild Utoya after the attacks by far-right terrorist Anders Behring Breivik that traumatized Norway in 2011. It was a defining experience in his life.
